scope: Independent source-contract, frozen-statement and actual exact-alias review; no new native run and no repeated hand-proof audit.

source_contract_checks.source_grammar: Every original admitted finite-degree word pair, every D >= 3, arbitrary signed shifts and kernel indices; admission has an exact checked equivalence to unchanged WordAllowed.
source_contract_checks.syntax: The literal row uses only original names zero and one; every occurrence of zero has identity word, and nonempty words occur only at one. The three output guards are finite disjunctions of literal negative/zero/positive row atoms.
source_contract_checks.ordered_comparison: All strict, equality and reverse-strict comparisons are equivalent under the original y <= x guard and the computed common tail.
source_contract_checks.domains: The common cutoff proves original, all selected-child, canonical-prepared and emitted-row domains without requiring y <= x. Each WordDomain includes actual dynamically reached arguments.
source_contract_checks.same_variable: A bounded computed three-way constant decides A(x) versus B(x) for every x on the same computed tail. Reversed terminal growth is paid, and the accumulated tie is applied to the terminal result.
source_contract_checks.computed_trace: The actual literal finite runner trace contains initial and terminal pairs. The compiler depends on D and source syntax only, not on eventual numeric inputs or evaluated word values.
source_contract_checks.effectivity: Bounded syntax operations and finish are primitive recursive. The all-input least-stopping search is total by the checked actual-child well-foundedness argument; Computable.find uses that proved termination. The complete compiler has a closed Computable theorem.
source_contract_checks.scope: The seven-conjunct frozen FullWordGuards includes all printed lem:guards clauses. A deterministic selected chain is sufficient; ordered partitions belong to the separate ranked-cancellation lemma.

frozen_revision_review.only_revision: Parentheses in the auxiliary BooleanGuardsCorrect place desired <= 2 outside the iff.

promotion_recommendation: Promote only paper08 lem:guards at the exact checked declaration. Ranked row cancellation, closed existential word decision, first-order BASE and the internal-level-two consumer remain separate pending obligations.
